First error-path try void (statement_timeout=1ms also cancels the Parse at connect; and an orphaned screen from a killed queue stopped the server mid-run)

label: e13
what: group commit (PG_GROUP_WRITES=1): the writes a pass sends on a write connection share one Sync (one implicit transaction, one commit); answered after its ReadyForQuery; on an error the failed one gets it, the rolled-back and skipped ones are reset (PgQuery.Retry) and resent
status: keep (default on, pending group test rerun)
why: server kinstr 66.8-66.9 vs 66.9-67.1; Postgres kinstr 321.2-322.3 vs 325.4-326.2 (-1.3%), kcycles 238.6/239.8/255.8 vs 254.3/263.2/269.5 (median -9%); p95 4.2-5.4 vs 5.6-6.8 ms, p99 5.5/11.1/33.6 vs 45.3/55.3/61.1 ms (at depth 16 writes queued behind each other's commit on one connection). grouptest round 1 (300 concurrent: 150 creates, 75 likes, 75 likes on a missing post, 1 thread): all creates 201 and in the database once with the answered ids, missing 404; rounds 2-3 failed on a test bug (same tag within one second; also failed with grouping off), rerun queued. 42/42 grouped
